system_tab.ai_type_help:
How each AI type behaves:
• Default (-1): Uses EasyRPG Player's own default setting as-is.
• RPG_RT: Behaves exactly like the original RPG Maker engine (reproducing its bugs too).
• RPG_RT+: Same as RPG_RT, but with the original engine's bugs fixed.
• ATTACK: Same as RPG_RT+, but uses only physical attacks and never skills.
